<thought>We need to find a retrosynthetic template that can disconnect the target molecule into two precursors by breaking a C‑C bond formed in a cycloaddition, while “losing” a ketone functional group in the forward direction. Searching the template catalog for reactions that break a ketone and form a C‑C single bond (6‑6) should give suitable candidates.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone"],
  "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
